name: BLOCK-T529
configuration_schema:
$schema: http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#
title: BLOCK-T529 configuration
description: Configuration for BLOCK-T529.
type: object
properties:
  program:
    description: Name of program
    type: string
    default: BLOCK-T529
  reason:
    description: Name of reason
    type: string
    default: daily calsys checkout
  config_tcs:
    description: Bool on config_tcs
    type: boolean
    default: False
  use_camera:
    description: Boolean on using camera
    type: boolean
    default: False
  ignore:
    description: Name of the CSCs we want to ignore
    type: array
    default: ['TunableLaser','CBP','Electrometer:101','Electrometer:102']
  sequence_names:
    description: List of sequence names to run for whitelight flats script.
    type: array
    default: ['whitelight_u_24_M385L3_source','whitelight_i_39_M730L5_source','whitelight_i_39_M810L3_source','whitelight_g_6_M455L4_source','whitelight_g_6_M505L4_source','whitelight_r_57_M565L3_source','whitelight_r_57_M660L4_source','whitelight_z_20_M850L3_source','whitelight_z_20_M940L3_source','whitelight_y_10_M1050L4_source']
  use_electrometer:
    description: override for mtcalsys use_electrometer
    type: boolean
    default: True
  use_fiberspectrograph_blue:
    description: override for mtcalsys use_fiberspectrograph_blue
    type: boolean
    default: True
  use_fiberspectrograph_red:
    description: override for mtcalsys use_fiberspectrograph_red
    type: boolean
    default: True
